evals.name: html-order-notification
evals.prompt: Create an HTML email template for order confirmation notifications.
evals.expected_output: Table-based layout (max 600px), all CSS inline, preheader text, logo header, order summary body, CTA button with VML fallback for Outlook, footer with unsubscribe link. PHP class with set()/render()/send() methods. Content-Type: text/html header. remove_filter after send. List-Unsubscribe header.

evals.name: background-email-queue
evals.prompt: Send welcome emails in the background so they don't block user registration.
evals.expected_output: Hook user_register. Queue via as_enqueue_async_action() not inline wp_mail(). Worker action sends email, throws RuntimeException on failure for AS retry. Correct headers (Content-Type, From). remove_filter wp_mail_content_type after send. Log wp_mail_failed.

evals.name: fix-raw-html-in-email
evals.prompt: The email is showing raw HTML tags instead of rendered content.
evals.expected_output: Check Content-Type header — likely missing or set to text/plain. Add add_filter('wp_mail_content_type', fn()=>'text/html') before wp_mail() and remove_filter immediately after. Confirm headers array includes 'Content-Type: text/html; charset=UTF-8'. Check email client isn't stripping inline styles.
